Language-2 recipe registries

Source: R/recipe_v2.R
recipe_add_concept_set.Rd

recipe_add_concept_set(), recipe_add_event() and recipe_add_interval() declare named nodes that other objects reference by name; the recipe_remove_*() functions remove one by name; recipe_set_publish() sets the publication roots (design section 2.10). They belong to the complete set of exported editing functions with recipe_add_population, recipe_add_block, recipe_add_variable, recipe_add_filter, recipe_add_output, their recipe_remove_*() counterparts, recipe_set_scope and recipe_set_options; omop_recipe(...) is the same recipe built in one call.

Usage

recipe_add_concept_set(recipe, concept_set)

recipe_add_event(recipe, event)

recipe_add_interval(recipe, interval)

recipe_remove_concept_set(recipe, name)

recipe_remove_event(recipe, name)

recipe_remove_interval(recipe, name)

recipe_set_publish(recipe, publish)

Arguments

recipe

An omop_recipe.

concept_set, event, interval

The object to declare (a registry concept set must be named; events and intervals without a name get a deterministic one when compiled). Declaring an existing name again with a different definition is an error.

name

Name of the node to remove.

publish

Character vector of output names, character(0) for none (every output is then a private computed input), or NULL for all.

Value

The modified recipe.

Examples

rec <- omop_recipe()
rec <- recipe_add_concept_set(rec, omop_concept_set(201826, descendants = TRUE,
                                                    name = "t2dm"))
rec <- recipe_add_event(rec, omop_event("condition_occurrence", "t2dm", name = "t2dm_dx"))
rec <- recipe_remove_event(rec, "t2dm_dx")
